dialog.dexrider.nine.lost.1: This world... the blocks, the square sun... where am I? I have to find the signal from Kagami-kun's Driver.
dialog.dexrider.nine.lost.2: Calm down, Nine. Think: if the Driver's signal reached this far, Kagami-kun must be close.
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_dex.1: That's Kagami-kun's Driver! ...But I don't know if you're really him. Prove it in a fight!
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_dex.2: If you're really Dex, your punches will tell me. Here I come!
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_player.1: Stay back! I don't know who you are or what this place is...
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_player.2: I'm really sorry! But I can't let anyone attack me here!
dialog.dexrider.nine.hurt.1: Agh! I'm pushing the power too hard... the suit doesn't hold it the same here.
dialog.dexrider.nine.hurt.2: Not yet... I can still keep going!
dialog.dexrider.nine.panic.1: %s?! Hang on, I'm coming! I won't leave you alone here!
dialog.dexrider.nine.panic.2: They're attacking %s! Smash, smash, no time to think!
dialog.dexrider.nine.convinced.1: That fighting style... the cards, the rhythm... it IS you, Kagami-kun! Sorry, I wasn't sure.
dialog.dexrider.nine.convinced.2: It's you... it's really you! I'm so sorry, I was afraid it was a trap.
dialog.dexrider.nine.retreat.1: I can't fall in a world I don't know! Retreating!
dialog.dexrider.nine.retreat.2: I need to regroup! I'll be back!
dialog.dexrider.nine.suit.1: My suit says the air here isn't breathable for me. If I transform back... I wouldn't survive. So I'll stay as Nine.
dialog.dexrider.nine.suit.2: The suit's system says this world's atmosphere would hurt me. I can't take it off, but I can still help you like this.
dialog.dexrider.nine.summoned.1: I'm here, Kagami-kun! Let's go together!
dialog.dexrider.nine.summoned.2: Nine, ready to fight! What's the plan?
dialog.dexrider.nine.home.1: Heading home to recover. Call me anytime!
dialog.dexrider.nine.home.2: I'll rest a bit. Take care, Kagami-kun!
dialog.dexrider.nine.down.1: Sorry... I overdid the power again...
dialog.dexrider.nine.down.2: I need... a moment... don't you give up!
dialog.dexrider.nine.chat.1: Hey, %s, does your suit warn you about the air here too? I'm scared of being stuck like this forever.
dialog.dexrider.nine.chat.2: %s, I've been writing down everything in this world. Creepers are terrifying!
dialog.dexrider.nine.reply.1: Yeah, %s! As long as we're together we'll figure it out.
dialog.dexrider.nine.reply.2: Haha, you're right, %s. Kagami-kun will get us out of here.
dialog.dexrider.nine.reunion.1: We're all here! Kagami-kun... you did it!
dialog.dexrider.nine.reunion.2: All together again... I can feel the Driver reacting.
dialog.dexrider.nine.portal.1: Look! The Driver's signal and ours are opening a portal!
dialog.dexrider.nine.portal.2: It's a portal! It's the way home!
dialog.dexrider.nine.farewell.1: Thank you for finding us, Kagami-kun. I'm leaving you my bike, take care of it. See you on the other side!
dialog.dexrider.nine.farewell.2: I'll never forget this world. If you need me, call and I'll cross back. The Nine Striker is yours!
dialog.dexrider.nine.return.1: I crossed the portal as soon as I heard you! Where's the danger?
dialog.dexrider.nine.return.2: I'm back! A hero always answers the call.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.lost.1: Signal from Yusuke's Driver... weak, but real. My son is in this world. I'll find him.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.lost.2: I got here by accident, but I'm not leaving without him. Let's follow the signal.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_dex.1: That Driver belongs to my son. If you're not Yusuke, you'll explain where you got it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_dex.2: You look like Dex. Let's see if you fight like him. Henshin!
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_player.1: I don't know you. Keep your distance.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_player.2: Easy. But if you come at me armed, I won't be.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.hurt.1: I'm getting too old for this...
dialog.dexrider.cipher.hurt.2: Fine... I've got your rhythm now. It won't happen again.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.convinced.1: ...Yes. I taught you that guard. You're Yusuke. Come here, son.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.convinced.2: That way of closing the distance... it's mine. It's you, Yusuke. Sorry for the test.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.retreat.1: I'm pulling back. Not worth finishing this here.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.retreat.2: Enough. I'm leaving before this gets ugly.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.suit.1: My Rider System filters this world's air, so I can take the suit off. The U.A. kids aren't that lucky.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.suit.2: The Kagami system adapts: I can walk around without the suit here. They can't... their suits say they wouldn't survive.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.summoned.2: Made it. Show me the target.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.home.1: Back to the workshop. Call me if you need me.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.home.2: I'll go check the gear. Take care, Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.down.1: Tch... I slipped. I need a while.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.down.2: I'm fine... I just need rest.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.chat.1: %s, how's the suit holding up? If you need me to check something, say so.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.chat.2: %s, stay close to Yusuke. He's stubborn, but he knows what he's doing.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.reunion.2: So that's what the signal was about... it was calling us all to you.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.portal.1: The Kamen Ride resonance opened the way. It's stable. Let's go.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.portal.2: A portal. They calibrated it together without realizing.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Cipher Runner, son. I tuned it myself. See you at home.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.farewell.2: I'll go first to secure the other side. The bike is yours. I'm proud of you.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.return.1: Crossed as soon as you called. What happened?
dialog.dexrider.cipher.return.2: I'm here. The portal still works fine.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.relax.1: Done. Taking this off, it's heavy.
dialog.dexrider.spore.lost.1: The spores don't recognize anything here... noko. Kagami-kun, where are you?
dialog.dexrider.spore.lost.2: If I spread the network far enough, I'll feel the Driver's signal... noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_dex.1: I feel Kagami-kun's Driver on you... but the spores aren't sure. Sorry, I have to check, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_dex.2: Is it really you? If it isn't... I won't let you keep his Driver!
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_player.1: Don't come closer, noko! The spores tell me everything you do!
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_player.2: Sorry... I don't trust anyone here yet.
dialog.dexrider.spore.hurt.1: Ow, ow, ow! This isn't my thing, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.hurt.2: I'm not a fighter... but I won't give up either.
dialog.dexrider.spore.panic.1: %s is in danger! The spores felt it, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.panic.2: No, no, no! Let go of %s!
dialog.dexrider.spore.convinced.1: The spores recognize you... you're Kagami-kun. Sorry I doubted, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.convinced.2: It's you... I stayed with you once when no one else did. I wasn't going to leave you now either.
dialog.dexrider.spore.suit.1: My suit says this air isn't good for me... noko. I can't take it off, but the spore network works perfectly here.
dialog.dexrider.spore.suit.2: I can't transform back in this world. At least the suit is comfy, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.summoned.1: Here I am, noko! The network's up: I know where everyone is.
dialog.dexrider.spore.summoned.2: I'm here! Who do we need to find?
dialog.dexrider.spore.home.1: Back to my mushroom home, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.home.2: Going to rest. The network keeps watch!
dialog.dexrider.spore.down.1: Uuh... I ran out of spores, noko...
dialog.dexrider.spore.chat.1: %s, did you know there are mushrooms here that almost glow? Almost, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.chat.2: %s, the spores feel something weird in the caves. Let's not go alone.
dialog.dexrider.spore.reunion.1: The spores feel all of us together! We did it, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.reunion.2: Everyone's here... I'm not scared anymore.
dialog.dexrider.spore.portal.1: The spores feel air from home on the other side, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.portal.2: A portal! It smells like our world!
dialog.dexrider.spore.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Myco Hurricane, noko. Its trail will warn you of everything. Thank you, Kagami-kun!
dialog.dexrider.spore.farewell.2: Goodbye... no, see you later. Call me anytime, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.return.1: Back through the portal, noko! What do you need?
dialog.dexrider.spore.return.2: The spores told me you were calling!
dialog.dexrider.forge.lost.1: Let's analyze calmly: a world of blocks, plentiful resources... and Kagami-san's Driver signal to the north.
dialog.dexrider.forge.lost.2: I must find Kagami-san. In the meantime, I can create whatever I need from these materials.
dialog.dexrider.forge.spot_dex.1: That Driver belongs to Kagami-san. Please forgive me, but I must verify your identity.
dialog.dexrider.forge.spot_dex.2: If you are Kagami-san, you'll know how to answer this strategy. En garde!
dialog.dexrider.forge.spot_player.1: Please don't come closer. I don't know your intentions.
dialog.dexrider.forge.hurt.2: I need more material to create!
dialog.dexrider.forge.panic.1: %s! Hold on, I'll create a shield!
dialog.dexrider.forge.convinced.1: That response... only Kagami-san would fight like that. My deepest apologies.
dialog.dexrider.forge.convinced.2: It's you. Forgive me for doubting, Kagami-san; it was the prudent thing to do.
dialog.dexrider.forge.retreat.1: I'll withdraw and rethink my strategy.
dialog.dexrider.forge.retreat.2: A tactical retreat is also a victory.
dialog.dexrider.forge.suit.1: My suit indicates the air here would be dangerous for me. I can't take it off, but I can create with it just fine.
dialog.dexrider.forge.suit.2: According to the suit's readings, I wouldn't survive this atmosphere without it. I'll remain as Forge.
dialog.dexrider.forge.summoned.1: Forge, present. What's the plan, Kagami-san?
dialog.dexrider.forge.summoned.2: I'm here. I already have three ideas for this fight.
dialog.dexrider.forge.home.1: Returning to my makeshift workshop. Call me when you need me.
dialog.dexrider.forge.down.1: I overdid the creating... I need rest.
dialog.dexrider.forge.chat.1: %s, I've catalogued this world's minerals. Diamond is surprisingly useful.
dialog.dexrider.forge.chat.2: %s, shall we build a decent shelter?
dialog.dexrider.forge.reunion.1: Everyone gathered. Kagami-san, your leadership was impeccable.
dialog.dexrider.forge.reunion.2: We did it. Now we can think about going back.
dialog.dexrider.forge.portal.1: Our Riders' resonance opened a stable portal!
dialog.dexrider.forge.portal.2: It's a portal. I estimate it will take us home.
dialog.dexrider.forge.farewell.1: I leave you the Machine Forger, Kagami-san. You can create bridges with it. It was an honor.
dialog.dexrider.forge.farewell.2: Thank you for everything. The bike is in your care.
dialog.dexrider.forge.return.1: I crossed as soon as you called. What shall I create?
dialog.dexrider.forge.return.2: Forge, back. I bring new ideas.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.lost.2: Everyone here can see me shine... so weird and so pretty. But I want to find Kagami-kun.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_dex.1: Kagami-kun?! ...Wait, what if it's not you? Let's see if you can catch me!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_dex.2: That Driver is Kagami-kun's! Prove it's you!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_player.1: Eeek! Stay back! I'll blind you!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_player.2: Oops, someone saw me! I need to get used to that!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.convinced.1: It IS you! Kagami-kun! I found you!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.convinced.2: It's you... sorry, sorry, sorry! I was so scared!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.suit.1: My suit says the air here is no good for me... so I can't take it off. But this way everyone sees me, and I love it!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.suit.2: I can't transform back here. That's fine: with the suit, everyone can see me.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.summoned.2: I'm here, Kagami-kun! Who do we dazzle?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.chat.1: %s! Did you see my reflection in the water? I look amazing!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.chat.2: %s, do you think this world has mirrors?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.reunion.1: We're all here! We did it!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.reunion.2: Everyone together! This calls for a party!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.portal.1: Whoa, a portal! It shines more than me!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Mirror Shooter! Nobody will be able to follow you! Thank you, Kagami-kun!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.farewell.2: See you soon! Call me and I'll come back shining!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.return.1: I'm back! Did you miss me?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.return.2: Crossed the portal! Shining as always!
dialog.dexrider.proto.lost.1: A whole world made of blocks! My babies and I could build anything here! ...But first, find Kagami.
dialog.dexrider.proto.lost.2: The Driver's signal... what an interesting frequency! Let's follow it.
dialog.dexrider.proto.spot_dex.1: That Driver! I want to see if it works like Kagami's! Field test!
dialog.dexrider.proto.spot_dex.2: Are you Kagami? Time to check with my babies!
dialog.dexrider.proto.panic.2: Nobody touches %s without going through my inventions!
dialog.dexrider.proto.convinced.1: You ARE Kagami! Your Driver responded just like in the workshop!
dialog.dexrider.proto.convinced.2: It's you! I knew my calculations were right!
dialog.dexrider.proto.suit.1: The suit says the air here is no good for me. I can't take it off, but it has four ports for my babies!
dialog.dexrider.proto.suit.2: I can't transform back here. Perfect: I get to work in the suit all day.
dialog.dexrider.proto.summoned.1: Proto, ready with a new module!
dialog.dexrider.proto.summoned.2: I'm here! What are we testing today?
dialog.dexrider.proto.chat.1: %s, can I install a thruster on your suit?
dialog.dexrider.proto.chat.2: %s, I found redstone! This changes everything!
dialog.dexrider.proto.reunion.1: Everyone together! And the combined signal is huge!
dialog.dexrider.proto.reunion.2: We did it! Can I study this before we go?
dialog.dexrider.proto.portal.1: A portal! I need to study it! ...Okay, let's cross first.
dialog.dexrider.proto.portal.2: It works! The signals made a portal!
dialog.dexrider.proto.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Proto Racer! It has module ports! Take care of it!
dialog.dexrider.proto.farewell.2: I'm taking this world's blueprints with me! See you, Kagami!
dialog.dexrider.proto.return.1: I'm back! And I brought upgrades!
message.dexrider.portal_closed: The portal closes. They went back to their world... but if you call them (B key), they'll cross back to fight with you.
dialog.dexrider.warden.lost.1: Signal from Yusuke's Driver, heading south. Protocol: locate, verify, protect.
dialog.dexrider.warden.lost.2: Got here by accident. Doesn't change the procedure: find my nephew and leave.
dialog.dexrider.warden.spot_dex.1: That Driver belongs to my nephew. Identify yourself or I'll do it for you.
dialog.dexrider.warden.spot_dex.2: Identity verification. I won't hold back.
dialog.dexrider.warden.spot_player.2: Keep your hands where I can see them.
dialog.dexrider.warden.hurt.2: Good. That was a good hit.
dialog.dexrider.warden.panic.2: Nobody lays a hand on %s. Nobody.
dialog.dexrider.warden.convinced.1: Four touches with overlapping tones... only you do that, Yusuke. Verified.
dialog.dexrider.warden.convinced.2: It's you. Noting it in the report: subject is who he claims. Good to see you.
dialog.dexrider.warden.retreat.2: Falling back. I'll return with backup.
dialog.dexrider.warden.suit.1: My Rider System filters the air: I can go without the suit here. The U.A. kids can't. Keep an eye on them.
dialog.dexrider.warden.suit.2: We Kagami adapt. I can take off the suit; they wouldn't survive this atmosphere.
dialog.dexrider.warden.summoned.1: Warden in position. Give me a target.
dialog.dexrider.warden.home.1: Back to my post. Let me know.
dialog.dexrider.warden.home.2: End of shift. You rest too.
dialog.dexrider.warden.chat.1: %s, everything in order? Report any anomaly.
dialog.dexrider.warden.chat.2: %s, I'm setting up a perimeter. Stay inside.
dialog.dexrider.warden.portal.2: The way is open. I'll bring up the rear.
dialog.dexrider.warden.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Warden Interceptor. Use it responsibly. See you at the Commission.
dialog.dexrider.warden.farewell.2: I'll cross last. Take care of your father... and yourself.
dialog.dexrider.warden.return.2: Came through the portal. Give me the report.
dialog.dexrider.warden.relax.1: Area clear. Taking off the suit.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.lost.1: Yusuke? I can feel his Driver... somewhere close. Oh, I hope he's eating well.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.lost.2: Three exits, a hill, a river... okay. Now to find my nephew.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_dex.1: That's Yusuke's Driver... but I have to be sure. Sorry if it hurts a little.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_dex.2: If you're my nephew, you'll know how to dodge from above. Here I come!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_player.1: Oh, who are you? Don't come too close, dear.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_player.2: Sorry, I can't trust anyone yet.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.hurt.1: Ow! I'm not telling anyone at home about this.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.panic.1: %s! Hold on, I'm coming down right now!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.convinced.1: It's you, Yusuke! Come here, let me hug you! ...Suit and all, I guess.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.convinced.2: It is you... sorry, sweetie. Here, I have a kitten sticker for you.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.suit.1: My Rider System lets me breathe here, so I can take off the suit. The little U.A. friends can't. We have to look after them.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.suit.2: I can walk around without the suit in this world. The kids can't... their suits say they wouldn't make it.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.summoned.1: Your aunt is here! Who needs a lesson?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.home.1: Heading home. Did you eat today?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.down.1: Oh... I need to sit for a bit.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.down.2: I'm fine, I'm fine... just tired.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.chat.1: %s, want a sticker? I have kitten ones.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.chat.2: %s, have you eaten? You look skinny.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.reunion.1: Everyone together! Like a real family!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.reunion.2: You did it, Yusuke. I'm so proud.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.portal.1: A portal... it smells like the mountain house.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.portal.2: The way home! Everyone hold hands, okay?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Psyga Glider, dear. It has a kitten on the tank. Fly carefully!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.farewell.2: See you soon. And this time we really are getting that ice cream.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.return.1: Your aunt is here! What happened?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.return.2: Flew right through! Where's the trouble?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.relax.2: All calm. Want me to bring you something to eat?
dialog.dexrider.orga.lost.1: Hmph. A world of blocks. My knee hates it. Where's the boy?
dialog.dexrider.orga.lost.2: Fifty years with the belt and I've never seen anything like this. I'll find Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.orga.spot_dex.1: That Driver sounds like my grandson's. Let's see if your cards lie as well as his.
dialog.dexrider.orga.spot_dex.2: I hear your cards, boy. If you're Yusuke, you know what's coming.
dialog.dexrider.orga.spot_player.1: Step aside. I have no patience and no knee for this.
dialog.dexrider.orga.hurt.1: My knee... never mind. Keep going.
dialog.dexrider.orga.hurt.2: Good. You hit like a Kagami.
dialog.dexrider.orga.panic.2: Touch %s and you deal with me, boy.
dialog.dexrider.orga.convinced.1: You cut the card mid-tone. I taught you that lie. You're Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.orga.convinced.2: No impostor fights this stubbornly. You're my grandson.
dialog.dexrider.orga.retreat.1: Hmph. Ten minutes with the belt and my knee begs for mercy. I'm out.
dialog.dexrider.orga.suit.1: My Rider System lets me go without the suit here. At my age, that's welcome. The kids from your school aren't so lucky.
dialog.dexrider.orga.suit.2: I can take off the belt in this world. Those youngsters can't. Protect them.
dialog.dexrider.orga.summoned.1: Hmph. I'm here. Make it quick.
dialog.dexrider.orga.home.2: I'm off. Call me if they overwhelm you.
dialog.dexrider.orga.down.1: Ten minutes... I can't take more.
dialog.dexrider.orga.chat.1: %s, have you ever listened to how the cards sound? Listen closely.
dialog.dexrider.orga.chat.2: %s, in my day we fixed this with tea.
dialog.dexrider.orga.reunion.2: Hmph. You did it. Your grandmother would be proud.
dialog.dexrider.orga.portal.1: A portal. The sound of all the cards together opened it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.portal.2: Finally. Let's leave this square world.
dialog.dexrider.orga.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Orga Monarch. Don't scratch it. I'll wait for you at the mountain house.
dialog.dexrider.orga.farewell.2: Cross whenever you want. And keep lying with your cards, you're good at it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.return.1: Hmph. I came. What is it?
dialog.dexrider.orga.return.2: Orga, back. Make it worth it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.relax.1: Belt off. My knee thanks me.
message.dexrider.spore_rod_anchor: Spore Rod planted: the network senses %s creatures
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.1: Yaoyorozu-san, how much material do you have left? If you need it, I'll cover you while you create.
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.1.r: Thank you, Midoriya-san. Half a minute is enough for a decent shield.
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.2: Yaoyorozu-san, your suit swaps halves... how do you decide which one? I want to write it down!
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.2.r: It depends on the problem, Midoriya-san: first the tool, then the material. Go ahead and note it.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.mirage.1.r: Yaomomo! Call me Toru! ...And thank you! Finally someone says it!
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.mirage.2: Hagakure-san, if you reflect the light of my magnesium flare, we could blind half an army.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.mirage.2.r: Shiny girls combo! I love it, Yaomomo!
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.1: Midoriya-kun! Can you see me? Tell me you can see me!
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.1.r: Y-yes, Hagakure-san! I can see you perfectly... it's weird, but I'm really happy.
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.2: Midoriya-kun, when we go back, do you think Kagami-kun will still see me like this?
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.2.r: He could already see you before, Hagakure-san. That won't change.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.1: Yaoyorozu, lend me a half! I just want to see how it fits the other one!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.1.r: Hatsume-san, it doesn't come apart. And no, not with a screwdriver either.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.2: Yaoyorozu, if your cannon had an expansion port...
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.2.r: It already has one, Hatsume-san. It's called "don't touch it".
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.nine.1: Midoriya! Can your suit take the recoil? Let me measure it with a sensor!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.nine.1.r: R-right now, Hatsume-san? We're in another world!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.nine.2: Midoriya, your Smash broke all my gauges. I love it!
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.1: Hagakure-san, the spores feel you just like in the forest, noko. But now I can see you too.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.1.r: Kinoko-chan! Like the night at camp... but this time nobody gets lost.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.2: Hagakure-san, aren't you scared of this world, noko?
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.2.r: A little. But I shine brighter when I'm with friends, Kinoko-chan.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.nine.1: Midoriya-kun, the spore network says there are creepers forty meters away, noko.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.nine.1.r: Thanks, Komori-san! You're better than a radar!
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.nine.2: Midoriya-kun, Kagami-kun talks about you a lot, noko.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.1: Mr. Kagami, could you check where my halves join? You understand modular Drivers.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.1.r: It's well made, Yaoyorozu-san. Better than my first belt.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.2: Mr. Kagami, how does your system handle this atmosphere?
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.2.r: It filters the air, Yaoyorozu-san. I wish yours did the same.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.1: Mr. Modular Driver! Can I see your belt? Just for a bit!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.1.r: No, Hatsume. Not here, not in the other world.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.2: Mr. Modular Driver! I made you an upgrade!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.2.r: Hatsume... what did you do to my belt?
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.warden.1: Isamu-san, about our secret meeting... is it still on?
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.warden.1.r: Keep your voice down, Hatsume. And yes.
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.warden.1: Agent Kagami, is there a protocol for block worlds?
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.warden.1.r: There is now, Midoriya. I'm writing it.
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.psyga.1: Nagisa-san! Can I have a sticker too?
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.psyga.1.r: Of course, Toru-chan! A shiny one, just for you.
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.spore.1: Kinoko-chan, do you want a little mushroom sticker?
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.1: Isamu, are you still writing reports for the Commission from here?
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.1.r: Out of habit, Takumi. Nobody gets them. I write them anyway.
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.2: Isamu, thanks for looking after Yusuke when I couldn't.
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.2.r: No need, Takumi. That's what uncles are for.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.1: Nagisa, count the exits. Out of habit.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.1.r: Already did, Isamu-nii. Three. And a river.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.2: Nagisa, stay behind me if this gets ugly.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.2.r: Isamu-nii, I fly. You stay behind me.
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.cipher.1: Takumi-nii... do you still have the kitten sticker?
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.cipher.1.r: It's still where you stuck it, Nagisa. I never took it off.
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.cipher.2: Takumi-nii, you eat too little. Have a manju.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.cipher.2: Takumi, your boy fights better than you did at his age.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.cipher.2.r: I know, Father. That's why I don't tell him.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.1: Isamu, stop writing down everything I do.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.1.r: It's protocol, Father. You're in the report too.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.2: Isamu... I never taught you about the tones, did I?
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.2.r: No, Father. I learned it from the boy.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.1: Nagisa, stop putting stickers on me.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.1.r: No, Dad. The kitten looks good on your knee.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.2: Nagisa, my knee is killing me.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.2.r: I told you to bring the cane, Dad.
dialog.dexrider.nine.form_change.2: Analyze... this calls for another form. %s!
dialog.dexrider.nine.rising.1: One For All, Full Cowl... fifteen percent! Rising!
dialog.dexrider.nine.rising.2: The suit can take the recoil... then I'm going all out! Rising!

dialog.dexrider.cipher.accel.1: Ten seconds. At seven I come back.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.accel.2: Accel. This is going to hurt... both of us.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.accel_end.1: Ugh... my body can't keep up. Time.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.accel_end.2: Ten... that's it. I need a moment.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.blaster.2: Dad kept this all these years... let's see if it still works.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.gift.1: Take the Accel, son. Seven seconds and you come back. Promise me.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.gift.2: I'm lending it to you. I built it at nineteen; it'll serve you better.
dialog.dexrider.orga.gift.1: I brought it from the mountain house. The Blaster gear is yours, boy. Use it better than we did.
dialog.dexrider.orga.gift.2: Takumi won't ask for it, so I'm giving it to you. The Blaster. Take care of it.

guide.dexrider.page1:
§4§lTAKUMI'S NOTEBOOK§r

If you're reading this, the Driver chose you.

It isn't a weapon. It's a tool to get there sooner.

§8— T. K.
guide.dexrider.page2:
§lHENSHIN§r

1. Carry the Dex Driver.
2. Right-click with Kamen Ride: Dex to load it.
3. §lV§r: KAMEN RIDE!

V again to go back. Your armor is stored in the chestplate.
guide.dexrider.page3:
§lTHE SUIT§r

+5 hearts, you take 25% less and hit 25% harder.

After 5 s without hits, light wounds close.

It can't be removed and isn't dropped on death.
guide.dexrider.page4:
§lSCANNING§r

While transformed, the Driver copies what it SEES in real use: weapons, powers, moves.

Within 20 blocks, in line of sight, looking at it.

Complex things need several samples.
guide.dexrider.page5:
§lWHAT TO SCAN§r

Swords, bows, tridents, lightning, guardians, golems.
Ghast, blaze, stray: forms.
Breeze: Gale. Vex: Razor Feather.
Explosions: Nitro Burst.
Mace or warden: Ground Wave.
Enderman: Overclock.
guide.dexrider.page6:
§lLEVELING UP§r

Scan something you already have and the card is replaced by a better version (Lv. 1-3).

Form Rides and Attack Rides grow this way. There's no going back.
guide.dexrider.page7:
§lFAMILIES§r

§dKamen Ride§r: identities.
§cAttack Ride§r: techniques.
§6Armed Ride§r: weapons.
§9Form Ride§r: forms (one at a time).
§aVehicle Ride§r: bikes.

Each card in a family makes it stronger.
guide.dexrider.page8:
§lKEYS§r

§lR§r form ability
§lShift+R§r basic ability
§lG§r open the Ride Booker
§lZ / X§r previous / next card
§lShift+Z/X§r switch deck
§lLeft Alt§r use the card
§lB§r Rider friends
guide.dexrider.page9:
§lRIDE BOOKER§r

Five decks: rescue, crowds, duel, chase and "everything went wrong".

Cards activate straight from the Booker, without taking them out.
guide.dexrider.page10:
§lATTACK RIDE§r

§lOverclock§r: everything slows down.
§lGale§r: wind that pushes and deflects.
§lRazor Feather§r: seeking feathers.
§lNitro Burst§r: detonations.
§lGround Wave§r: a wave through the ground.
guide.dexrider.page11:
§lTHE LOST§r

Other Riders fell into this world and don't know where they are.

Beat them in a real fight: their Kamen Ride joins your deck and they can become friends.
guide.dexrider.page12:
§lEMOTION§r

§5Violent§r: at the edge. Strength, speed and a price.

§9Heroic§r: when someone you protect gets hit.

In both, choosing a card uses it.
guide.dexrider.page13:
§lK-TOUCH§r

With nine Kamen Rides the Driver forges the K-Touch and a Complete Form card.

With ten, press every crest, yours included.
guide.dexrider.page14:
§lONE RULE§r

As long as someone is listening, there's still time to say "no" before.

Not after.

§8— T. K.

dialog.dexrider.kaixa.lost.1: Yusuke's Driver pulled me here. Dad will want a report.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.lost.2: Blocks. Everything is blocks. Fine: you can finish anything if you have the parts.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.spot_dex.1: That Driver sounds like my nephew's. Let's see if it fights like him.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.spot_dex.2: Kamen Ride... I know that tone. Prove it.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.spot_player.1: Stay back. I don't have time for explanations.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.convinced.1: You read my tones before I read yours. U.A. doesn't teach that. You're Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.convinced.2: Dad said only three people can read the cards. Now it's four. It's you, nephew.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.retreat.1: I'm pulling back. I don't leave things half done: I'll be back.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.retreat.2: Falling back. This ends another day.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.suit.1: My Rider System lets me take the suit off here, but I'd rather not in front of anyone.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.suit.2: Kagami adapt. Your U.A. friends wouldn't be so lucky with this air.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.summoned.1: Kaixa. Tell me what needs finishing.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.summoned.2: I'm here. You point, I finish.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.home.1: Back to the workshop. There's something I want to finish.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.home.2: I'm off. Call me if anything's left half done.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.down.1: Ugh... I need a moment. Just one.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.down.2: Out of the fight. Don't tell Dad.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.chat.1: %s, ever finished something without the blueprints? I have.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.chat.2: %s, the second drawer always has what you're looking for.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.reunion.1: All together again. Dad would be... well. He'd be.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.reunion.2: You found everyone. That's called finishing the job.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.portal.1: The portal holds. Go through, I'll watch the edge.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Cobalt Sidewinder. I finished it without blueprints, so take care of it. And call Nagisa: she misses you.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.farewell.2: Crossing. Next time we meet, we fight without tones.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.return.2: Came through the portal. Tell me where.
message.dexrider.ktouch_card2: The Driver forged a second Complete Form card: another group of nine, with Kaixa in Proto's slot.

note.dexrider.gunma.1:
Project Leash.

Goal: a Rider System that can be switched off from outside.

The wearer's fear opens the channel. We call it Violent Emotion.
note.dexrider.gunma.2:
Test 14.

The wearer keeps some control: they choose who to aim at, not whether to aim.

For us, that's enough.
note.dexrider.gunma.3:
Margin note, different handwriting:

"This isn't a leash. It's a wound we left open."
note.dexrider.gunma.4:
Subject 12.

Admitted at age twelve. Reflex modification complete. Responds well to pressure.
note.dexrider.gunma.5:
The subject asks about home every night.

Recommendation: do not answer.
note.dexrider.gunma.6:
The subject escaped during transfer.

A family wearer is being sent to retrieve them.
note.dexrider.gunma.7:
The basement gave way.

The columns weren't built for what happened down here.
note.dexrider.gunma.8:
Someone else was here that night. They shouldn't have been.

Close the laboratory.

message.dexrider.correa_cut: You said "no" in time. The leash lets go.

guide.dexrider.page15:
§lTONES§r

Every card sounds different. Orga and Kaixa read tones: don't repeat the same card.

§lShift+Alt§r: decoy.
Two cards in a row: overlapping tones.
guide.dexrider.page16:
§lTHE LENT DRIVER§r

Right-click a friend with the Driver: you lend it.

V without the Driver: you revoke it.

Each bearer leaves their form in your deck.
guide.dexrider.page17:
§lNO FEAR§r

Upgrade Form: born when the Driver has felt both Emotions.

Enter the Complete Form from it and the card rises to Lv.2.
